subject: Timur
prompt: Tamerlane, founder of the Timurid Empire, holds what distinction as a commander?
answer: He was never defeated in battle
why: Timur was undefeated across a career of conquest from Anatolia to India, and is rated among the greatest tacticians in history -- and among the most brutal.

subject: Shivaji
prompt: Shivaji was crowned Chhatrapati at Raigad Fort in 1674, founding which Indian kingdom?
why: He built it from a fiefdom his father had held under the Sultanate of Bijapur, and it grew into the power that outlasted the Mughals across much of India.

subject: Dagestan
prompt: Dagestan sits at the southernmost tip of Russia, on the shore of which sea?
why: It lies in the North Caucasus, bordering Azerbaijan and Georgia, with its capital Makhachkala on the Caspian coast.

subject: Eid al-Fitr
prompt: Eid al-Fitr falls on the first day of which month of the Islamic calendar?
why: The festival marks the END of Ramadan, so it falls not in Ramadan but on the first day of the month that follows it, Shawwal.

subject: Academy Award for Best Picture
prompt: The Academy Award for Best Picture is handed to whom?
why: The statuette goes to the film's producers. It is also the only category in which every Academy member may both nominate and vote.

subject: Linux
prompt: Strictly speaking, Linux itself is not a complete operating system. What is it?
why: Linus Torvalds released the kernel in 1991. A usable system pairs it with software from GNU, Red Hat, X.Org and others -- which is what a distribution actually is.

subject: Chinese New Year
prompt: Chinese New Year celebrations run for fifteen days and close with which festival?
why: The Spring Festival runs from New Year's Eve to the Lantern Festival on the fifteenth day of the new lunisolar year.

subject: Commonwealth of Nations
prompt: How many member states belong to the Commonwealth of Nations?
why: Most are former British Empire territories, though not all -- membership has since opened to countries with no imperial tie at all.

subject: Islamic calendar
prompt: A year on the Hijri calendar is how much shorter than a Gregorian one?
why: Twelve lunar months come to 354 or 355 days against the Gregorian 365, which is why Islamic dates drift backwards through the seasons rather than staying fixed.

subject: Indo-European languages
prompt: The Indo-European family is native to most of Europe, the Iranian plateau, and which other region?
why: The family stretches from Iceland to Bangladesh. Hindi, Persian, Greek, Russian and English all sit inside it.
